rv.q: I was a skeptic going in, but Mrs. Doubtfire proved to be an undeniably charming production that is a great launch for the 2024-2025. Fox Cities Performing Arts Center Broadway Across America season.
Jonathan Hoover's performance as Daniel Hillard/Mrs. Doubtfire is nothing short of spectacular.
Nevertheless, it's an enjoyable show that both pays homage to the movie — with some lines written word-for-word — and develops its own characters and storytelling.
Mrs. Doubtfire certainly warms hearts and has fun doing it with a wide variety of campy numbers that push the story forward.

cn.t: The touring production of Mrs. Doubtfire delights with technical wizardry—including 31 lightning-fast costume changes—and heartwarming family story, delivering both laugh-out-loud comedy and emotional resonance that captivates audiences.
